hookLine: Jon Burge's detectives tortured more than a hundred men inside a Chicago police station, and the only crime he ever went to prison for was a denial he signed in November 2003.

HOOK.secondary: February 1982 · a doctor examines a new prisoner

ACT_1.label: Home from Vietnam — Bronze Star, Purple Heart

events.text: Joins the Chicago Police Department
Detective, Area 2
Sergeant
Lieutenant — commands Area 2 Violent Crimes

ACT_1.secondary: Detective division covering the South Side
The detectives working under Burge on the midnight shift
Plastic typewriter covers, held over a man's head

ACT_1.label: The radiator in the interview room
HIS UNIT SAID: FIELD PHONE → THE BOX

ACT_1.quote: He plugged it into the wall and came towards me. He said, 'You're going to tell us what we want to know.'
ACT_1.attribution: Anthony Holmes, arrested May 1973 — federal trial testimony

ACT_1.label: The tally climbs: one man, five, twenty

events.text: Officers Fahey and O'Brien shot and killed at a traffic stop
Andrew Wilson arrested, taken to Area 2
Dr. Raba writes to Supt. Brzeczek
The letter is forwarded to the State's Attorney

ACT_2.label: Separate injuries counted at the county jail (roughly)
Burns in parallel lines — matching the radiator ribs

ACT_2.quote: a thorough investigation of this alleged brutality
ACT_2.attribution: Dr. John Raba, Cook County Jail, February 17, 1982

events.text: Illinois Supreme Court throws out Wilson's confession
Retried without it — convicted, life without parole
Wilson sues Burge in federal court; the first jury hangs
A federal appeals court sweeps the verdict aside

ACT_2.label: Anonymous letters from inside Area 2 — “Deep Badge”
Days between Melvin Jones and Andrew Wilson
Articles Conroy wrote on Area 2, over seventeen years

ACT_2.quote: included psychological techniques and planned torture
ACT_2.attribution: The Goldston report, Office of Professional Standards, 1990

ACT_2.secondary: Burge's forty-foot cabin cruiser — a name he said he picked at random

ACT_3.label: Years to file charges, from the moment the crank turned

events.text: Anthony Holmes tortured at Area 2
His clock runs out
Andrew Wilson tortured at Area 2
His clock runs out — the letter still unanswered

ACT_3.label: Torture claims the special prosecutors examined

items.label: Cases proved beyond a reasonable doubt

ACT_3.secondary: Condemned men whose confessions came out of Area 2

events.text: Gov. George Ryan freezes every execution in Illinois
Patterson, Hobley, Orange and Howard pardoned on innocence
Death row emptied — 167 sentences commuted

ACT_3.quote: Our capital system is haunted by the demon of error: error in determining guilt, and error in determining who among the guilty deserves to die.

ACT_3.secondary: Burge signs sworn answers denying he ever used or saw abuse

ACT_4.quote: There is no place for torture and abuse in a police station. There is no place for perjury and false statements in federal lawsuits.

ACT_4.secondary: October 21, 2008 — FBI agents arrest Jon Burge

ACT_4.quote: I didn't know if it was daytime or nighttime. He just kept shocking me.
ACT_4.attribution: Anthony Holmes, testifying at the 2010 federal trial

ACT_4.quote: I got justice, something I have been wanting for 28 years.
How can one trust the system of justice when the system is so defiled?

ACT_4.label: Months in federal prison — for lying about it

items.label: Criminal sentences ever served for Area 2

ACT_4.secondary: January 2011 — the board votes on Burge's pension

ACT_4.label: FOUR TO FOUR — A TIE MEANT HE KEPT IT

ACT_4.quote: I find it hard to believe that the city's political leadership could even contemplate giving 'Reparations' to human vermin.
ACT_4.attribution: Jon Burge, statement to a police blog, April 2015

ACT_4.quote: This is another step but an essential step in righting a wrong, removing a stain on the reputation of this great city.

ACT_4.secondary: Required in Chicago public schools — 8th grade and 10th, since 2018

events.text: Burge dies in Florida, pension intact, denials intact
Jackie Wilson declared innocent
Ground broken on a memorial, Martin Luther King Drive

ACT_4.label: The public bill by 2022 — and still climbing

ENDING.secondary: A thorough investigation — complete, sufficient, and buried

events.text: The letter is buried in a file
Convicted of lying about the torture
Chicago legislates reparations for his victims
The story enters every Chicago classroom

ENDING.label: Years from the doctor's letter to the city saying it out loud

lines: HE BEAT THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS

ENDING.secondary: It came back as a chapter
